name: Brasilotitan
sum: Brasilotitan is a small titanosaur with a squared-off snout from the early Maastrichtian Adamantina Formation of Brazil.
wsnote: Described as a small titanosaur; no figure was read.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted.
biology: The species name refers to a herbivorous diet.
author: Machado et al. 2013

images.artist: E. G. Nascimento, C. R. A. Candeiro, L. Vidal, E. F. Oliveira, T. C. Dias & S. Brusatte
images.caption: Holotype of Brasilotitan nemophagus.
